name: Patient
definition: An individual person registered in the cohort, uniquely identified by an integer patient identifier and carrying the demographic attributes that describe that person.
scope: Any analysis whose grain is one person, or that needs demographic attributes of a person named by a patient identifier.

name: Patient sex
definition: Recorded sex of a patient, stored as a single-letter code: 'M' for male and 'F' for female.
scope: Demographic stratification and any clinical threshold that differs between male and female patients.

name: Date of birth
definition: Calendar date on which the patient was born, stored as a date string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
scope: Birth-cohort filters and any age computation.

name: Patient age
definition: Age of a patient in whole calendar years, which is not stored as a column and must be derived from the date of birth relative to a reference date.
scope: Filters phrased as underage, years old, or older than a given age.

name: Patient-level diagnosis
definition: Disease or syndrome assigned to a patient in the patient master record. The field is a text value that may pack several comma-separated diagnosis codes and may qualify a code as suspected.
scope: Cohort-level identification of the disease a patient has or was referred for.

name: Examination-level diagnosis
definition: Disease or condition recorded on a specific clinical examination date. It shares the comma-separated multi-code text form of the patient-level diagnosis but is drawn from a wider vocabulary that also admits non-disease findings.
scope: Disease attribution at the granularity of a single examination event.

name: Suspected diagnosis
definition: A diagnosis entry whose text carries the qualifier 'susp', marking it as suspected rather than confirmed.
scope: Distinguishing confirmed from provisional disease assignments.

name: Diagnosis and visit date
definition: Encounter date attached to the patient record, held in the column named Description even though its content is a calendar date rather than prose. The workload uses it both as the date a diagnosis was made and as the date the patient came to the hospital.
scope: Year and date filtering of diagnoses and hospital visits at patient granularity.

name: First visit date
definition: Earliest recorded contact date of a patient with the hospital.
scope: Filters phrased as coming to the hospital after or before a given date.

name: Admission status
definition: Indicator of whether a patient was admitted as an inpatient or was instead followed at the outpatient clinic, stored as a short symbolic flag.
scope: Distinguishing inpatient admission from outpatient follow-up.
aliases: immediately followed at the outpatient clinic

name: Clinical examination record
definition: One clinical examination event of a patient on a given examination date, carrying the coagulation findings, autoantibody concentrations, observed symptoms and thrombosis severity recorded at that event.
scope: Any analysis at the grain of a single examination event.

name: Examination date
definition: Calendar date on which a clinical examination was performed.
scope: Year and period filters over examination events.

name: Thrombosis severity score
definition: Ordinal code describing the presence and severity of thrombosis recorded at an examination. The code 0 denotes absence of thrombosis; the non-zero codes denote progressively more severe thrombosis.
scope: Selecting patients by thrombosis severity, and the complement question of patients who do not have thrombosis.

name: Observed symptom
definition: Free-text description of the symptoms observed at an examination; recorded only for examinations at which symptoms were noted.
scope: Retrieving the symptoms of a selected examination.

name: Laboratory test record
definition: One laboratory panel of a patient on a given test date, holding the biochemical, haematological, immunological and coagulation measurements collected together on that date.
scope: Any analysis at the grain of one laboratory panel, and counting of laboratory examinations per patient.

name: Laboratory test date
definition: Calendar date on which a laboratory panel was performed; a patient may have many panels on different dates.
scope: Selecting laboratory measurements by date, month or year, and ordering repeated measurements of one patient in time.

name: Uric acid
definition: Serum uric acid concentration measured in a laboratory panel. Its normal band is sex-dependent.
scope: Questions that ask whether uric acid is within a normal range or is abnormal, and counts of patients by uric acid status.

name: Hematocrit
definition: Hematocrit level measured in a laboratory panel; values above the normal band indicate an elevated hematocrit.
scope: Questions about hematocrit exceeding the normal range and counts of such examinations.

name: Red blood cell count
definition: Red blood cell count measured in a laboratory panel; low values indicate a reduced red cell count.
scope: Questions about patients with a lower red blood cell count.

name: Lactate dehydrogenase
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase enzyme level measured in a laboratory panel; elevated values lie beyond the normal range.
scope: Questions about LDH beyond the normal range.

name: Prothrombin time
definition: Prothrombin time coagulation measurement in a laboratory panel; prolonged values are abnormal. The measurement is present in only a small fraction of panels.
scope: Questions about abnormal prothrombin time.

name: Immunoglobulin A
definition: Serum immunoglobulin A concentration measured in a laboratory panel, with a two-sided normal band.
scope: Questions about a normal IgA level.

name: Total cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol concentration measured in a laboratory panel.
scope: Questions about the level or the change over time of total cholesterol for a patient.

name: Anti-SM antibody
definition: Anti-Smith autoantibody result from a laboratory panel, recorded as a text value that mixes qualitative words with numeric codes rather than as a plain negative/positive flag.
scope: Questions about a normal or non-positive anti-SM result.

name: Anti-cardiolipin IgM antibody
definition: Anti-cardiolipin IgM antibody concentration measured at a clinical examination, expressed as a numeric concentration on a wide scale.
scope: Questions about the anti-cardiolipin antibody concentration status of a patient on an examination date.

name: Normal range of a laboratory measurement
definition: The band of values of a laboratory measurement that is considered clinically normal. No normal-range column exists in the data; the applicable band is measurement-specific and, for uric acid, sex-specific.
scope: Interpreting the words normal, abnormal, within a normal range, or beyond the normal range in a question about a laboratory measurement.

name: Abnormal laboratory result
definition: A laboratory measurement lying outside the normal band for that measurement and for the sex of the patient, defined as the complement of the normal band.
scope: Selecting or counting measurements described as abnormal rather than normal.

name: Laboratory value change rate
definition: Relative change of a laboratory measurement of one patient between two dates, defined as the difference of the two measurements divided by the later measurement.
scope: Questions asking for the decrease rate or change rate of a measurement between two months or dates.
